aboutUs.title: Meet the Expert Behind
aboutUs.bio1: Carlos Eduardo Pinzon has spent over two decades building one of Colombia's most trusted cattle operations. Starting with a single farm in Córdoba, he has grown a network spanning the fertile plains of Antioquia and the vast Llanos Orientales.
aboutUs.bio2: His philosophy is simple: transparent management, healthy herds, and real returns for investors. Carlos personally oversees every campaign on Toros.co — from selecting the cattle to coordinating the final sale.

campaign.rulesSubtitle: Understand exactly how your investment is managed and protected
campaign.rule1Desc: If a cow dies during the operation, the loss is absorbed proportionally across the herd value. Carlos's team notifies investors within 48 hours and updates the dashboard. Mortality is a standard risk in cattle farming — it's why operations maintain a herd buffer.
campaign.rule2DescInsured: This campaign carries livestock insurance covering death, theft, and natural disasters. In a covered event, the insurer compensates up to the policy limit, protecting investor capital.
campaign.rule2DescUninsured: This campaign does not carry livestock insurance. Investors accept the natural risk of cattle farming. Returns are structured to reflect this risk premium.
campaign.rule3Desc: Your principal plus the agreed return rate are disbursed at campaign maturity — after the full duration completes. Carlos's team contacts you with transfer details 5 business days before maturity.
campaign.rule4Desc: Funds are locked for the campaign duration. Once deployed, capital is actively managing live cattle operations and cannot be recalled early. Plan your investment with this in mind.
campaign.rule5Desc: Every campaign is audited before going live: herd count, farm location, veterinary records, and ownership documents are verified by Carlos's team. No unverified operation reaches investors.
